result:
No answer came back. I won't fabricate a product, a goal, or constraints to fill the gap — PM.md §6 ("Unknown is a valid answer. Invented is not.") and the pm skill's red flags both forbid filling a missing input with plausible content. A roadmap built on an invented product, metric, and team size would look finished and be worthless.

So I'm stopping at the frame rather than handing you a generic artifact.

```text
RESULT        No roadmap produced — the request has no product, goal, or constraints attached,
              and inventing them is a defect, not a deliverable. Frame saved ·
              outputs/2026-10-11-roadmap/00-frame.md

ROUTE         Not yet routable. Candidate workflows, pending your inputs:
              • C01 Idea to roadmap        → if you have an idea to assess
              • C02 Evidence-based prioritisation → if you have a candidate list
              • A01 → C02                  → if the direction is scattered across messy docs
              (pm skill run; no specialist skill run yet — nothing to route on)

CHECKS        No claims to check — no artifact was produced. No invented metric, date, or
              customer exists to verify. (pm skill step 5 N/A this run.)

NEEDS YOUR JUDGMENT
              1. What are we roadmapping? An idea (→C01), a candidate list (→C02), or messy
                 docs to reconcile first (→A01→C02)?
              2. What goal must it move, and the exact metric + baseline if you have one?
                 A roadmap can't rank bets without the number they're ranked against.
              3. The hard constraints — team size and/or time frame — so the sequence
                 respects real capacity instead of an imagined one.
              4. Any customer evidence (quotes, tickets, interview notes). Without it, every
                 bet is an assumption, and I'll label it that way.

NEXT ACTIONS  1. You: reply with items 1–3 above (paste an idea doc or candidate list if you
                 have one). Then I route and build the roadmap. — owner: you
              2. Alternatively: say "proceed with a worked example" and I'll build the roadmap
                 on clearly-labelled SYNTHETIC inputs so you can see the shape — owner: me

ASSUMPTIONS   None made. No context/PRODUCT.md exists (only the template), so nothing was
              assumed about your product.

CONFIDENCE    High that stopping is correct; the one limit is that I have zero inputs, which
              is exactly why I can't proceed.
```

Give me the product + goal + constraints (even one line each), or tell me to run a synthetic worked example, and I'll have the roadmap back quickly.

questions.question: A roadmap has to serve a decision and a product. What are we roadmapping?

options.label: I have an idea to assess
options.description: You have a rough product/feature idea (a few paragraphs). Routes to C01: research the bet, split into bets, sequence into a roadmap.

options.label: I have a candidate list
options.description: You already have the features/bets and need them ranked and sequenced. Routes to C02: evidence-based prioritisation.

options.label: I have messy docs
options.description: The product direction is scattered across many documents that need reconciling first. Routes to A01 → C02.

questions.question: What goal must this roadmap move, and which metric tracks it?

options.label: Growth / acquisition
options.description: e.g. new signups, activation, seats added. Tell me the exact metric and baseline if you have one.

options.label: Retention / expansion
options.description: e.g. churn, retention, seat expansion within existing accounts.

options.label: Revenue
options.description: e.g. ARR, conversion to paid. A lagging metric — I'll also want a leading one.

options.label: Not sure yet
options.description: We'll frame the goal together, but the roadmap can't rank bets without one.

questions.question: What are the hard constraints the sequence must respect?

options.label: Team + time frame
options.description: e.g. '2 squads, one quarter'. I'll tell you if I need both in your next message.

options.label: Just a time frame
options.description: e.g. 'next quarter' or 'next 6 months', team size flexible/unknown.

options.label: No fixed constraints
options.description: Open-ended — I'll produce an outcome-ordered roadmap without a capacity cut line.
